meaning: 我超兴奋能置身真实城堡
usageNote: excited to do sth 就是'为某事兴奋到飞起'，real castle强调'真的不是假的'，语气超级开心！

examples.en: I was so excited to be in a real castle that I ran through every room.
examples.zh: 我兴奋到在每个房间里跑来跑去，因为我真的置身于一座城堡！

examples.en: She was so excited to finally see the ocean for the first time.
examples.zh: 她超级兴奋，因为终于第一次看到了大海。
